_doc: A6000-host served Qwen3.6-35B-A3B for decoupled-serving runs. `name` is the model id the GPU host's vLLM server advertises at /v1/models (the weights path passed to serve_vllm.sh). The agent sends `name` as the request model, so it MUST equal the served id — use this same MODEL_CONFIG on both serve_vllm.sh and run_tb_client.sh. `enable_thinking` rides the harness extra_body (chat_template_kwargs) and needs an extra_body-forwarding harness image. The default name below is a concrete placeholder path.
